feed.title: CoHDL blog
feed.subtitle: Writing about the language, the compiler, and the boards built with them.

entry.title: CoHDL 0.6.0: An EasyEDA Backend and the STM32 Catalog
entry.summary: The compiler now writes EasyEDA / LCEDA Pro netlists — verified end to end with a real import — and the registry gains STM32 and ESP32 device catalogs generated from pinned vendor sources.

entry.title: CoHDL 0.5.0: Native KiCad Boards and a Live Schematic Explorer
entry.summary: The compiler now writes .kicad_pcb board files itself, a new explorer renders any checked design as a searchable, live-reloading schematic, dependencies resolve transitively, and the macOS binaries are signed and notarized by Apple.

entry.title: CoHDL: An AI-Native Programming Language for Hardware
entry.summary: Software has crossed the AI-native threshold; hardware design is still trapped in canvases and PDFs. CoHDL turns circuit topology into typed source code with a compiler, registry and downstream handoff formats.
